assertions.unit: % drift in err_ppb between the m_p pin and the stale muon pin
assertions.source: |err_ppb(canonical) − err_ppb(stale)| / |err_ppb(canonical)|. Above 0.01%, discipline lock §4 rules the candidate out as form-fitted to one q₀; the branch above states that rule and the witness never carried the number.

description: Q_β bridge experiment #3: multi-block eigenphase weighted by fundamental-rep quantum dimensions (informed by PR #1521's fundamental-rep lesson). Tests q₀-stability across canonical and stale q₀ pins. Discipline lock: q₀-drift > 0.01% rules the mechanism OUT (same criterion as the 6 prior bridge mechanisms).
caveats: The bridge does NOT close: residual -1.1897e+7 ppb at the canonical pin, against a 0.001 ppb compute-precision bar. Verdict 'open (q₀-stable but not Taylor-exact)'. The q₀-stability assertion above says only that the candidate is not form-fitted to one pin; it is not evidence that the candidate is right.
